summary.bn: আকাশের স্যাটেলাইট থেকে নিজের অবস্থান বের করে, প্রতি সেকেন্ডে সিরিয়ালে (৯৬০০ বড) NMEA বাক্য পাঠায়।
summary.en: Works out where it is from satellites, and sends NMEA sentences over serial (9600 baud) once a second.

simplified: It sends the NEO-6's default sentences (RMC, VTG, GGA, GSA, GLL) at 9600 baud once a second, as u-blox gives; the bytes arrive at that speed. Its setup messages (UBX) are not modelled: it keeps its defaults.

Whether it has a fix, where it is and how many satellites it sees are set in the inspector. A real receiver needs open sky and about half a minute from a cold start; the lab has the fix as soon as it is set.
Its clock starts at an example date (23 November 2026, 06:00 UTC) when it is powered, as the lab has no real clock. Speed is always 0 and height 9 m.
It is the common module with its own regulator, for 3.3 V to 5 V. Its TX line is a 3.3 V signal. Its supply current is an estimate.
